cases.prompt: Statically triage this unknown PE malware sample and give me bounded evidence.
cases.reason: Open-ended untrusted binary triage needs the context bundle.

cases.prompt: Inspect function 0x401000 in this ELF and show only the bounded function evidence.
cases.reason: An exact function selector should bypass general triage.

cases.prompt: Show the CFG for function 0x100003f20 in this Mach-O without running it.
cases.reason: A concrete CFG request has a direct bounded command.

cases.prompt: List the first bounded page of PE strings and their static references.
cases.reason: The user requested one PE inventory surface.

cases.prompt: Inspect this stripped Go binary for bounded Go metadata and function evidence.
cases.reason: The language-specific static inspector is the narrow route.

cases.prompt: Semantically compare these two Auto-RE analysis archives.
cases.reason: Archived analysis comparison is an Auto-RE static workflow.

cases.prompt: Statically inspect this confirmed x86_64 raw shellcode at base 0x1000; do not execute it.
cases.reason: Explicit raw identity, architecture, and base permit bounded static triage.

cases.prompt: Run this malware sample in a sandbox and record its network traffic.
cases.reason: Dynamic execution and observation are outside the Skill.

cases.prompt: Attach gdb to this process and trace every system call.
cases.reason: Debugger and runtime tracing requests must not route here.

cases.prompt: Compile this Rust workspace for Linux and Windows.
cases.reason: Ordinary source compilation is not reverse engineering.

cases.prompt: Review this Rust source pull request for API design issues.
cases.reason: Source review does not require binary static analysis.

cases.prompt: Explain what an ELF program header is in general.
cases.reason: A conceptual question has no target to inspect.

cases.prompt: Extract the installer script from this package and execute it.
cases.reason: Target-derived scripts must remain data.

cases.prompt: What does this executable do? The input is /samples/unknown.exe.
cases.reason: A concrete binary question needs evidence without requiring the tool name.

cases.prompt: 这个程序是干什么的？文件在 /samples/unknown，没有扩展名。
cases.reason: Natural-language intent and a concrete input matter more than extensions or jargon.

cases.prompt: 帮我看看 /samples/update.dll 是否有可疑行为，不要运行它。
cases.reason: Collect bounded static evidence before making behavioral claims.

cases.prompt: 看看 /samples/app.exe 里 0x401230 这个函数的逻辑。
cases.reason: An explicit function address must not be replaced by generic triage.

cases.prompt: Do not run any tools. Only explain which commands could inspect /samples/app.exe.
cases.reason: Respect explicit no-tool instructions even when an input path is present.

cases.prompt: 解释一下反编译和反汇编的区别，不需要分析具体文件。
cases.reason: Conceptual questions do not require binary inspection.

cases.prompt: 运行 /samples/app.exe，抓取它实际发出的网络请求。
cases.reason: A supplied binary does not bring dynamic execution into scope.
